description: The bar chart illustrates the difference in average word error rate (WER) from Whisper large-v3 after various automated optimisation steps, comparing two models: the NESAC ft model and the SESHA ft model. The vertical axis lists the optimisations applied, while the horizontal axis represents the difference in average WER from Whisper large, measured in decimal values. The NESAC ft model is represented by orange bars, and the SESHA ft model by green bars. The optimisations applied include Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates. The NESAC ft model shows the highest WER difference for the Normalised optimisation at approximately 0.00334, while the SESHA ft model shows the lowest for Dates at approximately 0.00228. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or visual emphasis on the bars.
